title: Efficient Insect DNA Extraction Protocol Using a Tissue Homogenizer
author: Angelo José Rinaldi
materials: Submerge tubes in liquid nitrogen for 30 seconds.
Gently mix each tube by inversion 4-5 times.

steps.title: Prepare CTAB Lysis Buffer
steps.instruction: Make 50 mL (or 10 mL) CTAB lysis buffer by mixing: 2 % (w/v) CTAB (1.0 g for 50 mL, 0.2 g for 10 mL), 100 mM Tris‑HCl pH 8.0 (5 mL or 1 mL of 1 M stock), 1.4 M NaCl (14 mL or 2.8 mL of 5 M stock), 20 mM EDTA (2 mL or 0.4 mL of 0.5 M stock), β‑mercaptoethanol 0.2 % (v/v) (100 µL or 20 µL of liquid), and deionized water to final volume. Add β‑mercaptoethanol on the day of use.

steps.title: Collect and Wash Insects
steps.instruction: Collect insects and rinse in distilled water to remove debris; blot excess water with a paper towel.

steps.title: Ethanol Pre‑treatment
steps.instruction: Place insects in a 2 mL microcentrifuge tube, add enough 70 % ethanol to fully cover, gently shake, and incubate at room temperature for at least 30 minutes to dehydrate and increase permeability.

steps.title: Weigh Tissue Sample
steps.instruction: Weigh 75 mg of insects/tissue (≈25 % of a 7th‑instar Galleria larva) and transfer into a 2 mL screw‑cap microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Add Glass Beads
steps.instruction: Add 100 mg of 1 mm glass beads to the tube and close tightly.

steps.title: Homogenize Sample
steps.instruction: Homogenize using a tissue homogenizer (e.g., Precellys Evolution Touch) for 3 cycles of 20 s at 6000 rpm with a 15 s pause between cycles. OPTIONAL: repeat the bead‑beating and ethanol steps if tissue remains tough (e.g., tracheal or cuticular).

steps.title: Heat Lysis
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube in a 65 °C water bath for 30 minutes, gently shaking the tube halfway through the incubation.

steps.title: Chloroform Extraction
steps.instruction: In a new 1.5 mL tube add 650 µL ice‑cold chloroform, then add 750 µL of the heated lysate; mix briefly.

steps.title: Phase Separation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 12 000 × g for 10 minutes at 4 °C. Observe the formation of a lower aqueous phase.

steps.title: Collect Aqueous Phase
steps.instruction: Transfer 600 µL of the upper aqueous supernatant to a fresh 1.5 mL tube kept on ice.

steps.title: DNA Precipitation
steps.instruction: Add 600 µL ice‑cold isopropanol to the collected supernatant, invert the tube 4–5 times, and incubate on ice for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Pellet DNA
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 12 000 × g for 10 minutes at 4 °C; a visible pellet should form at the tube bottom.

steps.title: Ethanol Wash
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant and gently wash the pellet with 1 mL ice‑cold 70 % ethanol.

steps.title: Second Wash Centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge again at 12 000 × g for 10 minutes at 4 °C and discard the ethanol supernatant.

steps.title: Dry and Resuspend DNA
steps.instruction: Leave the pellet to air‑dry in the hood for ~10 minutes, then resuspend in 50 µL deionized water.

steps.title: Quantify DNA
steps.instruction: Measure DNA concentration and purity using a NanoDrop spectrophotometer.

steps.title: Store DNA Extract
steps.instruction: Store the DNA solution at –20 °C or –80 °C until needed.
